summary: Iteration 8 — independent, API-level (public ingress) verification of the SIMULATED-action-never-earns-attribution mandate. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_simulated_attribution.py (10 tests, 10/10 PASSED). CONFIRMED: (1) real case order_TWKE56rzzX1S63 (source RAZORPAY_TEST) is NATURALLY_RECOVERED / attribution NONE / recovered_amount 0.0 / natural_recovered_amount 500.0 / verification_status VERIFIED, an executed SIMULATED SEND_RECOVERY_LINK is on record, and the CASE_CLOSED audit reason explicitly says the SIMULATED SEND_RECOVERY_LINK was disregarded ('simulated executions never earn attribution on provider-sourced cases ... NOT counted as system-recovered revenue'); the /replay timeline exposes the same closure with attribution_strength NONE. (2) Metrics: natural_recovered_not_counted.INR = 817,404 includes the 500; verified_gross_recovery.INR (462,700) equals the exact sum of recovered_amount over all VERIFIED_RECOVERED cases and the case is absent from that set; re-POST /cases/{id}/verify is a no-op (already_closed) and verified_net_recovery is unchanged. (3) Regression via the Webhook Test Lab (server-side signing only, secret never handled): scenarios late-success and replacement-payment each create a fresh RAZORPAY_TEST case whose only executed action is SIMULATED, then settle it — both close NATURALLY_RECOVERED / NONE / recovered 0 (NOT VERIFIED_RECOVERED). (4) Manual path: lab payment.failed -> POST /cases/{id}/execute (SEND_RECOVERY_LINK, simulated) -> server-signed success settlement on the same order => NATURALLY_RECOVERED / NONE / 0 with the SIMULATED close reason. (5) Diagnostics endpoint returns masked metadata only (key_id_prefix/lengths/present flags); scanned /integrations, /razorpay/health, /razorpay/events, /webhooks/config, /settings — no key_secret, webhook_secret, Authorization or Basic values anywhere; unauthenticated diagnostics -> 401/403. Did NOT run the full pytest suite, did not touch /config, /disconnect or /test-connection. Backend error log clean.

minor.issue: The fix is forward-only with NO backfill: verify_case() returns 'already_closed' for CLOSED_CASE_STATUSES, so cases closed before the fix keep their old attribution. Audit (scripts/it8_audit_verified_provider.py) shows ALL 14 RAZORPAY_TEST cases currently VERIFIED_RECOVERED (INR 42,000, order_LAB* lab cases closed 2026-08-29..08-31) were attributed to a SIMULATED SEND_RECOVERY_LINK with ZERO genuine (non-simulated) actions — real_actions=0 for every one. So Verified Net Recovery (INR 457,378) still contains INR 42,000 that the new mandate says must never be attributed, and GET /api/integrations/razorpay/health reports recovered_outcomes_detected=14 from the same stale rows. Recommend a one-off re-attribution migration (recompute attribution for closed provider-sourced cases whose creditable actions were all simulated -> NATURALLY_RECOVERED/NONE/0 + a CASE_REATTRIBUTED audit event), otherwise the dashboard still overclaims.

Endpoint named in the review request does not exist — routes_integrations.py only exposes POST /razorpay/test-lab/{test_name} with a fixed scenario list; 'deliver' falls through to 404 'Unknown test lab scenario.' There is no way to deliver a signed payment.captured for an ARBITRARY existing order via the lab, which is exactly what the manual-execute regression needs. I had to settle the manual-execute case through POST /api/simulate/payment-event (server-signed) instead. Consider adding a lab 'deliver' scenario accepting {event, order_id, amount} so provider-sourced regressions never require touching the webhook secret.

Lab runs leave their cases behind permanently (24 order_LAB* cases created in the last 30 min alone, 181 provider cases total). They are correctly attribution NONE / recovered 0 so revenue KPIs are safe, but they inflate active/at-risk case counts and provider health counters. Add a lab-case cleanup or an is_lab flag excluded from KPIs.

action_items: Decide on (and likely implement) a one-off re-attribution migration for the 14 already-closed RAZORPAY_TEST cases (INR 42,000) whose VERIFIED_RECOVERED attribution rests solely on SIMULATED actions — today they still feed verified_gross/net_recovery and health.recovered_outcomes_detected, contradicting the mandate.

Optional: add a generic POST /api/integrations/razorpay/test-lab/deliver (event + order_id + amount, server-signed) so provider-case regressions can be driven end-to-end without handling the webhook secret.
Optional: clean up / flag order_LAB* lab cases so they stop inflating active-case and provider-health counters.
critical_code_review_comments: detection.py close_case_on_success: _creditable() correctly gates on (real_source and simulated) for both executed_before and executed_after, and disregarded_simulated only inspects actions at/or before settlement — semantics are exactly as mandated and verified live. Keep ATTRIBUTABLE_ACTIONS as the single source of truth.

detection.py verify_case: the early 'already_closed' return makes every attribution rule change silently non-retroactive. Any future attribution-semantics change needs a paired migration script; consider a re_attribute_closed_cases(dry_run=True) utility so this is a one-liner next time.

routes_cases.py manual_execute now has the pre-execution settle guard (matches run_case_pipeline) — the iteration-7 gap is closed; /cases/{id}/replay now uses the shared _audit_for_case helper, so the iteration-7 lineage drift is fixed too.

rca_of_the_issue: The mandated fix (detection.py _creditable excluding simulated actions on RAZORPAY_TEST/LIVE cases) is implemented correctly and verified live end-to-end on both the real case and freshly created lab cases.
